state:
**Goal `php-oracle-retired`: Stage 6 (no list maps PHP to Novis), file set 1 is on disk; file sets 2 and 3 are next.** ADR 0274 (`docs/decisions/0274.md`) is the goal's record.

On disk: `nvs_stdlib::php_names`, its test file and the build-time join are gone; `crates/nvs-stdlib/build.rs` now builds only the reference intros. `nvs_hir::PhpFunctions` and its argument are gone, so `E0320` always gives its general help (`an_undefined_free_function_gets_the_general_help`), and `E0319`'s help no longer names the migration table. The LSP has no PHP-name completion layer, no `PhpNames` setting, and `nvs.completion.phpNames` left `editors/vscode/package.json`, its test, the editor chapter and `rule:ide/contributions-are-frozen-and-only-ever-added` (which now says a setting leaves only with its feature). Four conformance cases, the `.lspt` case and `docs/reference/tools/50-agents.md` print the general help.

`tools/data/php-builtins.txt` is NOT deleted yet: `tools/nv/cmd/migration.ts` and the CI job `migration-table` still read it, so it goes with them in file set 2.

next.note: one file set: the migration spec and its data, the tools that read them, the `Replaces` column and the gates. Goal prose § *Stage 6*, item 2.

items.text: **The migration list and its inventory are deleted** — `docs/spec/02-php-migration.md:1`, `data/spec/php-migration.json`, `phpMigration` in `tools/nv/renderers/spec-tables.ts:1`, `tools/nv/schema/spec.ts:1`, `tools/data/php-builtins.txt:1`, `tools/dump-php-builtins.php:1`, `tools/nv/cmd/migration.ts:31`, the reference topic at `tools/nv/cmd/reference.ts:507` (Part D), `tools/nv/proofs/roster.ts:1` and `tools/nv/test/render.test.ts:1`; the playbook bullet `tooling/a-plain-php-tools-dump-php-builtins-php-writes-a-smaller` goes with the generator.

**The gates over the list are deleted** — `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/spec_registry_coverage.rs:1` (`every_migration_member_row_has_a_conformance_case`, `every_migration_member_row_names_a_registered_member`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/migration-members-outstanding.txt`), the CI job at `.github/workflows/ci.yml:515`, `MIGRATION_GATES` at `tools/nv/cmd/session.ts:512`, and `guardedBy` in `data/rules/core-api/removals.json`.

**Comments that cite the migration table are rewritten whole** — `crates/nvs-db/src/pg.rs:1`, `crates/nvs-repo/src/lib.rs:1`, `crates/nvs-runtime/src/environment.rs:1`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/compress.rs:1`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/env.rs:1`, `docs/reference/README.md:1` (each has one `02-php-migration` hit; `git grep -n 02-php-migration -- crates docs/reference` finds the line).

backlog: File set 3: the five PHP-name rules (`php-migration/completion-php-names-setting`, `every-php-builtin-is-a-completion-candidate`, `the-php-name-layer-is-joined-at-build-time`, `an-item-inserts-only-a-registered-member`, `ide/three-of-four-item-shapes-insert-nothing`) and ADR 0111's retirement — goal prose § *Stage 6* item 3.
`docs/novis.md` is regenerated with `bun nv reference` after the pipeline `nvs` is rebuilt; a stale binary fails the two `50-agents.md` examples.
Stages 8–10 (rules state the behaviour, the reader's text steps back, rendered and proven) — goal prose.
